reason: Our architect already does 3D for us, and I bill cost-plus, so a $1,500 line item only gets in if the homeowner agrees to pay for it. Most of my clients come from referrals and past buyers who don't ask for this.
objection: I'd be paying twice for something my architect already hands me, and I'd have to talk a homeowner into covering $1,500 a home across a library of 20-100 plans.
would_change_my_mind: If it came out clearly cheaper and better than what my architect gives me, and homeowners agreed to pay for it as an upgrade, or it measurably helped sell spec homes.
